name: Manchester City

tactical_patterns.build_up: Short passing from back, GK involved in build-up. FBs invert into midfield zones. Single pivot (Rodri) drops between CBs.
tactical_patterns.attacking: Overloads in half-spaces. Width from inverted wingers and overlapping FBs. Late runners into box. High sustained possession.
tactical_patterns.defensive: High press triggered by opponent GK or CB receiving ball. Counter-press immediately on loss. Compact midfield block when settled.
tactical_patterns.set_pieces: Dangerous from corners (near post flicks). De Bruyne delivery from free kicks. Haaland primary aerial target.
tactical_patterns.transitions: Quick vertical passes on turnover. Haaland stretches defensive line. Vulnerable to fast breaks when FBs are high.

weaknesses: Over-reliance on Rodri for midfield control
High defensive line exploitable with long balls
Can struggle against deep compact blocks

name: Real Madrid

tactical_patterns.build_up: Patient build-up through midfield. Kroos-style ball progression from deep. FBs provide width.
tactical_patterns.attacking: Devastating transitions with Mbappé and Vinícius. Bellingham late arrivals in box. Crosses from wide areas.
tactical_patterns.defensive: Mid-block with compact shape. Rely on individual brilliance to recover. Press selectively on triggers.
tactical_patterns.set_pieces: Strong aerial threat from corners (Rüdiger, Bellingham). Direct free kicks from Mbappé.
tactical_patterns.transitions: Elite counter-attacking speed. 3-4 seconds goal-to-goal. Mbappé-Vinícius combination lethal on break.

weaknesses: Midfield can be overrun by pressing teams

name: Liverpool

tactical_patterns.build_up: GK distribution to FBs. TAA inverting as playmaker. Quick vertical progression through midfield.
tactical_patterns.attacking: Salah cutting inside from right. Robertson overlaps on left. Third-man runs from midfield. Direct passing into channels.
tactical_patterns.defensive: Aggressive high press in opponent's half. Gegenpressing on loss. Compact mid-block when press is beaten.
tactical_patterns.set_pieces: TAA delivery from corners and free kicks. Van Dijk primary aerial target. Near-post routines.
tactical_patterns.transitions: Fast vertical play on turnovers. Salah stretches play. Midfield runners support quickly.

weaknesses: Can be disrupted by physical midfields
Transition defending when press is broken
